name: calendar-lag-ff-sf
why: Calendar-day lag on FF and SF, and a negative calendar lag on SS, in both passes. Holiday Mon 8 Mar 2027. Indices: 0-4 = Mon 1-Fri 5 Mar, 5 = Tue 9, 6 = Wed 10.

a.why: From b (FF, calendar): b's latest finish instant is Wed 10 Mar (it ends Tue 9), minus 3 = Sun 7; the last 5-day finish with instant on or before Sun 7 is index 5. From c (SF, calendar): c's latest finish instant Wed 10 minus 2 = Mon 8; the last start on or before Mon 8 is index 4 (Fri 5), + D_a 5 = 9. LF = min(PF 6, 5, 9) = 5. FF = min(3 - 3, 0 - 0) = 0.

b.why: a's finish instant is Sat 6 Mar, + 3 days = Tue 9 Mar 00:00. b must finish at or after that: ending Fri 5 gives Sat 6 (too early), ending Tue 9 gives Wed 10, so EF = 6 and ES = 6 - 3 = 3 (Thu 4, Fri 5, Tue 9). Backward: d's bound is index 7 (below), so LF = PF 6. FF = ES_d 1 - result 1 = 0.

c.why: a starts Mon 1 Mar, + 2 = Wed 3 Mar; c must finish at or after Wed 3 00:00, which ending Tue 2 does: EF 2, ES 0.

d.why: b starts Thu 4 Mar, minus 2 calendar days = Tue 2 Mar = index 1. Backward to b: d's latest start index 2 = Wed 3, plus 2 = Fri 5; the last start on or before Fri 5 is 4, + D_b 3 = 7, above PF 6.
